question: In a certain code language, STEAMER is coded as 81, and CRUISE is coded as 75. How will SUBMARINE be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Position value according to the English alphabetic series are added.

​So,

 
• STEAMER is coded as 81​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e163117d7c931c79b719082f7554be73a9e85efda6bb6cec55d5418d55333191.png] ​

​And,

 
• CRUISE is coded as 75​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3814203aacd42900b796222c8375c83b61459e44615e16934461170f5e74f7.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• SUBMARINE is coded as :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f25bcce97734e1c68ae4021c1e60314f689411b4c2499edee9e2cde325fbf5aa.png] Hence, "102" is the correct answer.
